llm.summary: The skill appears coherent with a YouTube-scoring API client and only needs a WorthClip API key, but there’s a notable mismatch between the documented homepage (worthclip.com) and the actual API base URL (a convex.site subdomain) which could indicate misconfiguration or an unexpected backend — review before installing or providing credentials.

dimensions.detail: The name/description, required binary tools (curl, jq), and single required env var (WORTHCLIP_API_KEY) align with a simple API client that scores YouTube videos. However, SKILL.md documents a base API URL at https://greedy-mallard-11.convex.site/api/v1 while the skill homepage is worthclip.com and the description instructs users to get keys from worthclip.com/developers — this domain mismatch is unexpected and not explained in the documentation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions limit the agent to running the provided shell scripts (score.sh, feed.sh, usage.sh) which are expected to call the API, poll jobs, and return JSON. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading unrelated files or env vars beyond WORTHCLIP_API_KEY. Because the skill includes executable scripts, the exact behavior depends on their contents (not fully shown here); you should inspect the scripts to confirm they only call the documented API endpoints and do not exfiltrate other data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec — this is an instruction-only skill with shipped scripts. That minimizes install-time risk (no downloads or archives). The presence of scripts means running them will execute code locally, but nothing is automatically written to disk by an installer step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API credential (WORTHCLIP_API_KEY) is required and is declared as the primary credential, which is appropriate for an API client. There are no additional unrelated secrets or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not set always:true, and disable-model-invocation is true, so the model cannot autonomously invoke this skill; it must be explicitly invoked by the user. This limits risk from persistent or autonomous credential usage.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing or providing your WORTHCLIP_API_KEY, do the following: 1) Inspect the contents of scripts/score.sh, feed.sh, and usage.sh to confirm they only call the documented API endpoints and do not read or transmit other files or environment variables. 2) Verify the API base URL — ask the vendor (worthclip.com) whether their API is hosted at the convex.site subdomain or whether the skill should use a worthclip.com domain; mismatched endpoints are a red flag. 3) If you proceed, use a limited-scope or test API key (not production credentials) and monitor usage. 4) Prefer verifying the skill’s source/maintainer (unknown owner ID here) and checking official WorthClip developer docs or contacting support to confirm the integration is legitimate.
